prompt:
Minimalist portrait 4:5 Meta social ad, 1080x1350 feel, solid matte charcoal background #1A1A1A, no photo, no texture, no gradient, no logo, no button, no icons, no emoji, no watermark text besides the copy.

Centered classic high-contrast white serif typography, elegant thin serif like Garamond or Times, four lines, vertically and horizontally centered, generous negative space.

Exact Spanish copy, perfectly spelled, no extra words:
Si sos
coach,
te queremos en
Orlis.

Quiet authority, editorial, premium, high contrast white on charcoal.
